releases.body: Match native OpenCode spacing: keep consecutive single-line tool calls compact and add separation after multiline content or expanded output. Task rows retain separate spacing. Verified with 15 regression tests and actual terminal expand/collapse interactions.

Initial release: each tool call keeps its own input summary; click to expand output underneath. Includes native file diffs, Ctrl+O toggling, and a full tool-record viewer. Tested with OpenCode 1.18.27 in Otty. Includes English and Chinese installation, update, and uninstall instructions. Local regression suite: 14 tests passed.
